digest.component_or_area: inbound reconciliation — parent field differ and snapshot enrichment
propositions: When a Jira parent is removed, the inbound differ never emits parent_id=None because it collapses 'Jira has no parent' and 'parent key is unresolvable' into the same None state and refuses to emit lest it accidentally clear a locally-set parent.
The fetcher deliberately omits the parent field from snapshots when the parent is None (treated as absent), making a de-parented issue indistinguishable from one that never had a parent.

A clear of an inbound parent requires positive evidence the peer once had that parent — merely observing no parent now is insufficient and caused an incident that destroyed 63 parent edges when the managed_refs gate alone was used.
The fix uses ADR-0026 per-binding peer state to record whether the peer was ever observed with a parent, so a clear is emitted only when peer evidence exists plus this pass observes no parent.
The snapshot schema and all consumers must distinguish 'parent field absent' (unobserved/truncated read) from 'parent field present with None value' (queried and genuinely parentless).
